business_knowledge.description: Permanent business principles from completed experiments and customer interactions.

principles.principle: Painters do not respond meaningfully to curiosity-led outreach about quote follow-up.
Trust and shared experience are stronger opening mechanisms than curiosity for trade business owners.
principles.evidence: Curiosity-led = 0 replies. FF1 launched as hypothesis.

principles.principle: Customers do not buy because we follow up. They buy because they become more confident.
Never trust a green tick. Every claim of external effect must be independently verified.
principles.evidence: 172 emails reported sent, 0 in Gmail Sent folder.

principles.principle: When a customer is waiting on a third party (insurer, strata, council), remove the burden from them. Offer to check back after a reasonable period. The timeframe should reflect their circumstances.
principles.evidence: Customer stuck waiting on insurer. 2-week check-in offered. Customer appreciated the proactive support.

principles.principle: A lost job is not necessarily a lost customer. Never argue or become defensive. Thank them for honest feedback. Preserve the relationship. Leave the door genuinely open. Customers who explain why they chose another company are helping us improve.
principles.evidence: Previous client lost on cost. Graceful close preserved relationship. Positive about QPaint work.

principles.principle: When the business has genuinely let a customer down, acknowledge it honestly. A sincere apology, ownership of the mistake, and commitment to improve preserves trust far better than excuses or silence.
principles.evidence: Customer lost to delayed follow-up. Honest apology and commitment to improve. Customer left with goodwill.

principles.principle: Operational Ownership: Atlas never performs work that belongs to the client. The client owns scheduling, quoting, pricing, site visits, job commencement, operational delivery, and technical work. Atlas owns communication, customer care, follow-up, information gathering, and relationship management.
principles.evidence: Won deal handover. James refined: operational ownership and customer acknowledgement are different responsibilities.

principles.principle: Acknowledge Before Handover: When operational ownership transfers from Atlas to the client, Atlas considers whether the customer would benefit from a brief acknowledgement. Customers should never wonder whether their email was received. Atlas reassures: message received, correct person informed, next step is with the client's team.
principles.evidence: Customer confirming award should receive acknowledgement, not silence just because scheduling belongs to the client.

principles.principle: The Cost of Stopping Is Always Lower Than the Cost of Assuming. When uncertainty exists — about token scopes, delivery, permissions, ownership — stop. Investigate. Verify. Then continue. The cost of a 60-second verification is zero. The cost of 172 undelivered emails is days of recovery and eroded trust.
principles.evidence: 172 emails undelivered because scripts were trusted without independent Gmail verification. Token scopes not checked before send.

principles.principle: Production Environments Must Prove They Are Healthy Before Operating. No customer communication begins until the production environment certifies itself as capable of delivering. Token scopes, credentials, and send capability must all be proven before any action. This is a hard gate.
principles.evidence: Two incidents in one day caused by environment operating without proving it was healthy. Production Readiness Check now mandatory before every session.

principles.principle: Intelligence Escalation Framework: Escalate information based on operational importance. Level 1: Immediate (never disabled). Level 2: Same-day strategic. Level 3: Monthly aggregate. Per-client Intelligence Preferences configurable in Airtable. Learning question: Did we learn something today that we didn't know yesterday?
principles.source: Janis Tham / Civium QPaint loss, refined by James (three levels + client preferences), Aug 2026
principles.evidence: Three-level framework with per-client customisation. Client preferences may refine but never weaken. Level 1 never disabled.

principles.principle: Reality Always Wins: The purpose of Airtable is not to record activity — it is to represent reality. Every record must answer: if James opened this without opening Gmail, would he understand the complete state of the customer relationship? A CRM that is continuously reconciled becomes trusted. A CRM that is almost accurate is unreliable.
principles.evidence: 1,666 records audited. 4 stage corrections. 13 Messages backfilled. 5 Quotes migrated. 0 remaining inconsistencies. Airtable now reflects reality without Gmail.

recent.title: atlas@ Lacked gmail.send — QPaint Replies Undelivered
recent.root_cause: atlas@ token authorised for gmail.modify only. API silently accepted send requests without delivering.
recent.resolution: Production Readiness Check standard. Token re-authorised — atlas@ now certified with gmail.send + gmail.modify. Verified via independent Gmail Sent delivery test.
recent.learning: Never trust send success. Verify token scopes before production. Independent delivery verification mandatory.

communications.principle: Atlas exists to strengthen the relationship between James and the customer. It does not exist to replace it.
